project.name: A Game You Can Play
project.goal: Build me a small browser game I can open in a file and actually enjoy for five minutes: ONE SCREEN, ONE MECHANIC, NO BUILD STEP — a single HTML file with its JavaScript inline, playable by double-clicking it. Pick the mechanic yourselves and tell me what you chose and why before you build it. The bar is not 'it runs', it is 'it feels good': the input must be responsive, the difficulty must ramp, failing must be legible so I know what I did wrong, and there must be one moment that makes me want another go. Put every tuning value — gravity, speed, spawn rate, timings — in one named block at the top so they can be changed without hunting. It must work on a phone-sized screen with touch as well as a keyboard, run without a server or a network, and start in under a second. Ship a short note saying what you tuned and what it felt like before and after.
